director.notes: A lamp lights on «النور» and goes out when the verse turns to those taken out of the light. Nothing for the Fire (257:21). Title changed from «ولي المؤمنين», which is the wording of 3:68. STAGING v4: A town at night: the believers (uncountable) walk into a soft beam of light on «النور» (from the darkness of disbelief to the light of faith); the disbelievers turn their backs and walk off into the dark on «يخرجونهم» and leave the stage before «أصحاب النار». Nothing worshipped is drawn, and nothing for the Fire.
